Hey, Hollins Family Ties — I wanted to say this here so everyone knows: I’m coming to Thanksgiving, and I’m looking forward to seeing you all.

I’ll bring mac and cheese and two sweet potato pies. I have Thursday, November 26 at Aunt Denise’s in Macon, eating around 3, on my calendar.

I’ve been thinking about last year. I’m proud of the work I do, but I’m sorry for how I talked at the table. I took a jab instead of keeping my cool, and I hate that Grandma Pearl ended up spending so much of the holiday out on the porch. I still feel bad about that.

I’m not looking to reopen the argument or put anyone on the spot. I’d just love for us to call a truce on work and politics for the day. I can’t discuss open cases anyway, so questions about “the lawsuit” are a dead end. How about we keep the table to food, football, babies, and Tasha’s new boyfriend? That sounds like a much better way to spend Thanksgiving together.

I know we can get under each other’s skin sometimes, but there’s a lot of love in this family too. A birthday text—even one thumbs-up emoji—can mean a lot. I want this to be a good day, and I’m glad I’ll be there.
